1.w: of David. Unto You, O YHWH, I lift up my soul.

2.w: My God, in You I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies rejoice over me.

3.w: Indeed, all those waiting on You will not be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be ashamed.

4.w: May You show me Your ways, O YHWH; may You teach me Your paths.

5.w: Make me to walk in Your truth and teach me, for You [are] the God of my salvation; on You I wait all the day.

6.w: Remember Your mercies, O YHWH, and Your loving devotion, for they [are] from of old.

7.w: May You not remember the sins of my youth, and my transgressions; according to Your loving devotion, may You remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, O YHWH.

8.w: Good and upright [is] YHWH; upon thus, He directs sinful ones in the way.

9.w: He guides the humble ones in justice, and He teaches the humble ones His way.

10.w: All the paths of YHWH [are] loving devotion and truth, to those keeping His covenant and His decrees.

11.w: And for the sake of Your name, O YHWH, may You pardon my iniquity, though it [is] great.

12.w: Who [is] this man, the one fearing YHWH? He will direct him in the way he must choose.

13.w: His soul shall dwell in goodness, and his seed shall possess the land.

14.w: The counsel of YHWH [is] with those fearing Him, and He makes known to them His covenant.

15.w: My eyes [are] continually toward YHWH, for He brings out my feet from a net.

16.w: May You turn to me and show favor to me, for I [am] lonely and afflicted.

17.w: The troubles of my heart have enlarged; may You bring me out from my distress.

18.w: Look on my affliction and my trouble, and lift all my sins.

19.w: See my enemies!—For they are many, and with violent hatred they hate me.

20.w: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

21.w: May integrity and uprightness keep me, for I wait for You.

22.w: May You redeem Israel, O God, from all his distress.
